name: flowblocks-ui-toolbar
description: Reusable flow diagram blocks - UI toolbar

scripts.verify:dist: npm run packem && git diff --exit-code --stat -- dist
scripts.build: npm install --registry http://0.0.0.0:4873 && npm update --registry http://0.0.0.0:4873  && npm run coverage && npm run packem
scripts.remote-publish-patch: npm install && npm update && npm run coverage && npm run packem && git commit -am 'wip' && npm version patch && npm publish && git push origin && git push origin --tags
scripts.remote-publish-minor: npm install && npm update && npm run coverage && npm run packem && git commit -am 'wip' && npm version minor && npm publish && git push origin && git push origin --tags
